record.question: Yellow head virus of shrimp is transmitted by:
record.explanation: Held: printed page 2 confirms the four listed animal vectors, but established YHV transmission includes infected shrimp tissue, cohabitation and contaminated water, which are absent. Birds may be the intended response, but a 2004 experimental study found no viable YHV after gut passage through chickens or seagulls; a YHV-specific basis for choosing any listed vector is missing (https://experts.arizona.edu/en/publications/seabirds-as-potential-vectors-of-penaeid-shrimp-viruses-and-the-d/; transmission experiment: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.aquaculture.2014.11.038).
